messages:
Ava (PM): Quick thread: AcmeAudit wants an "auditable" console view: per-model daily cost, error clusters with sample traces, and a trace tag for model_id so auditors can correlate. Can we scope an MVP for next sprint?
Ravi (Eng-ML): We can add model_id span tag relatively quickly. Exact per-token cost needs billing join later.
Maya (SRE): Requirements: default PII redaction, retention 30d, and canary roll (48h). Keep sampling low by default (0.5%).
Tom (DevEx): UX: shareable link + CSV export for cost rows. I can mock UI if APIs exist.
Ava (PM): Proposed MVP-lite: 1) model_id span tag, 2) dashboard tile: estimated daily cost (note: provisional), latency & error rate, filter by model_id, 3) error analytics: grouped errors + 3 sample traces each, 4) CSV export skeleton, 5) canary single-runtime 48h + redaction.
Ravi (Eng-ML): ETA if we mock cost: ~10 dev-days (tagging 2d, API 3d, UI 2d, canary infra 2d, docs 1d).
Maya (SRE): Must not ship without redaction and canary. I'll write runbook and alert rules.
Ava (PM): Acceptance checklist in ticket > spans present, dashboard shows estimated cost, error groups + samples (3), CSV export, canary + alerts, perf <3% p99, redaction in place. Locking scope if no objections by EOD. :thumbsup:
Ravi (Eng-ML): +1
Maya (SRE): +1
Tom (DevEx): +1
Ava (PM): Creating ticket now. audit-bot: ticket OBS-900 created and linked.
